question: Which of the following metals has the highest conductivity of all the metals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silver**__.

__
 
• **Silver has the highest conductivity of all metals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__**Silver**__

__
 
• Atomic number - **47.**
 
• Mass number - 107.87.
 
• Chemical symbol - Ag.
 
• Silver belongs to the second transition series and group 11 elements of the periodic table.
 
• Silver belongs to D-block elements.
 
• Silver is a **lustrous, soft, very ductile and malleable metal.**
 
• It has the **highest electrical conductivity of all metals**, but it is **not widely used for electrical purposes as it is very expensive.**
 
• Silver is **not a chemically active metal,** however nitric acid and hot concentrated sulfuric acid will react with it.
 
• Silver does not oxidize in the air, it reacts with hydrogen sulfide in the air, causing the metal to tarnish due to the formation of silver sulfide.
 
• Silver can be obtained from pure deposits as well as from silver ores such as **horn silver and argentite.**
 
• It can also be obtained as a **by-product** along with deposits of ores containing **gold, copper, or lead.**
 
• Silver products require **regular cleaning.**
 
• Silver is **stable in water**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__**Aluminum**__

__
 
• Atomic number - **13.**
 
• Mass number - **26.981.**
 
• Chemical symbol - **Al.**
 
• Aluminum belongs to **group 13 and the boron family.**
 
• Aluminum belongs to **P-block elements.**
 
• **Hall Heroult's process** - Production of Aluminium.
 
• Aluminum is extracted from **bauxite.**
 
• The Aluminium compound is used for making precious stones artificially - **Aluminium oxide.**
 
• The double sulfate of Aluminium - **Alum.**
 
• Alum is used** for purifying water **and used as a** mordant.**
 
• The alloy of aluminum widely used in aircraft construction **- Duralumin.**
 
• Aluminum is the metal that is used to **make CDs.**
 
• Aluminum is the metal that is used in **reflecting telescopes.**

**​Iron**__

__
 
• Atomic number - **26.**
 
• Mass number - 55.84.
 
• Chemical symbol - **Fe.**
 
• Iron belongs to the** first transition series and group 8 elements** of the periodic table.
 
• Iron belongs to **D-block elements.**
 
• **Haematite, Magnetite, Iron pyrites** are the ores of Iron.
 
• The impure form of Iron is called **Pig Iron.**
 
• Iron is a **shiny greyish colour, bright white metal that is soft, malleable, ductile and strong.**
 
• Its surface is usually **discolored by corrosion **since it combines readily with the oxygen of the air in the presence of moisture.
 
• In absolutely dry air, **it does not rust.**

**​Steel**__

 
• Steel is **an alloy of iron and carbon.**
 
• Bessemer process - Production of Steel.
 
• Steel is the most important **construction material.**
 
• 
 
The most important properties of steel are great **formability and durability, good tensile and yield strength, and good thermal conductivity.**
